text:
Platinum Price in 1995
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1995, the LBMA platinum price fell 3.1% between 1995-01-31 ($415) and 1995-12-28 ($403). The highest sampled price was $449 in April and the lowest was $403 in December. The mean of these observations was $424. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
